newsitem.title: USA: Marquee Group names Jan Chason CFO.
newsitem.headline: Marquee Group names Jan Chason CFO.

text.p: Marquee Group Inc said Wednesday it named Jan Chason chief financial officer, replacing Donna Coleman who resigned to take a job with an unidentified other company.
Marquee provides production and marketing services to sporting events, sports television shows and professional and collegiate leagues and organizations.
Chason was previously the liaison between Marquee and Sillerman Cos on financial matters, according to a statement released by Marquee and Sillerman.
A spokesman for both companies said Sillerman is a privately-owned "affiliated company" in the same business but would not elaborate.
